caseNameFull: Watkins v. Bordenkircher, Warden and Summitt v. Bordenkircher, Warden

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari in No. 79-5949 granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition. Certiorari in No. 79-5951 granted. Cases consolidated and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.
